action_ledger_code_check.name: action_ledger_code_check
action_ledger_code_check.value:
("action_ledger"."error_code" is null or "action_ledger"."error_code" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$')
        and ("action_ledger"."blocked_reason" is null or "action_ledger"."blocked_reason" ~ '^[a-z_]{1,64}$')

project_links_target_check.name: project_links_target_check
project_links_target_check.value:
("project_links"."target_type" = 'conversation' and "project_links"."conversation_id" is not null and "project_links"."evidence_item_id" is null)
        or ("project_links"."target_type" = 'evidence' and "project_links"."evidence_item_id" is not null and "project_links"."conversation_id" is null)
